column1: # THE FEATURE SCOPES (BUILD-DELTA #36; Codex batch-3 r6 MAJOR 1 and the IOI Director's amendment (2)): every conclusion of
# DEPENDENCY-REVIEW.md that rests on a dependency FEATURE, re-derived by the gate in EVERY pinned configuration from cargo
# metadata's resolved graph of that configuration, never from manifest text.
# - A row with a canary feature is a surface that exists only behind that feature. It is ON in a configuration whose
#   inventoried packages (ioi-node, ioi-services) resolve the package as a direct dependency with the feature: there the
#   gate passes the canary feature and requires the canary to report each `deny-in <scope>` entry once; where it is OFF
#   the inventoried code cannot name the surface and the canary lines are compiled out (0 reports).
# - A row with `-` is a feature the review relies on being OFF (it lists nothing behind it): resolved for the package
#   anywhere in the graph the inventoried build reaches, in any configuration, it FAILS until the review is re-opened.
# scope<TAB>package<TAB>feature<TAB>canary feature (- = must be off)<TAB>what the review concludes
